semantics: Native: physical OM4 targets. Annual: five-day observed surface bins. Draw 1 is independently sampled at each lead, not a coherent trajectory. Spread is pointwise sample standard deviation (ddof=1), not error.
scales: Physical limits use pooled reference 1st/99th percentiles across selected leads. Error and spread limits use pooled 99th percentiles across runs and selected leads. Errors are prediction minus reference. RMSE is unweighted over finite ocean cells, a map diagnostic, not the blended rollout score.
